args.query: For all site–year–quarter events, filter to those where sumTU for algae > 0.0001 and sumTU for fish > 0.0001. For each such event compute the ratio r = (fish sumTU) / (algae sumTU). Return the average (mean) of r and the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of r. Also ensure zero or null values are excluded appropriately by the filters.

MATCH (site:Site)-[ra:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(:Species {name: 'algae'})
MATCH (site)-[rf:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(:Species {name: 'fish'})
WHERE ra.year = rf.year

  AND ra.sumTU > 0.0001
  AND rf.sumTU > 0.0001
WITH site.name AS site_name, ra.year AS year, ra.quarter AS quarter,
     ra.sumTU AS algae_sumTU, rf.sumTU AS fish_sumTU
WITH site_name, year, quarter, avg(fish_sumTU) AS fish_sumTU, avg(algae_sumTU) AS algae_sumTU
WITH toFloat(fish_sumTU) / toFloat(algae_sumTU) AS r
RETURN avg(r) AS mean_r,
       percentileCont(r, 0.025) AS p2_5,
       percentileCont(r, 0.975) AS p97_5
